text_block_list.text:
In the morning, having woken up earlier than usual,
I was taking a stroll along the riverbank when—

Mihono Bourbon came sprinting up
the riverbank slope at an incredible speed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Completed 20 reps of 'slope runs'.
Remaining quota: 30 reps."
choice_data_list: Are you doing independent training right now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my father told me the slopes by the riverbank were "good for the legs."
It's been part of my daily routine since before I enrolled.

Even so, there's another training menu this afternoon.
Using up too much stamina in the morning would be...
choice_data_list: (Still, that just shows how much she wants to give it her all.)
(Still, that just shows how much she wants to give it her all.)
(...Better hold back on that after all.)

text_block_list.text:
And so, Mihono Bourbon continued running up and down
the slope until the very last minute before school started—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
All processes complete.
Increase in leg power confirmed.

Seeing her breeze through such intense exercise
made me truly feel how much she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Next up on the schedule... 30 minutes until school starts.
I can... still... make... i...—"

Having drained all her energy during her morning routine,
I gave her a ride to the academy.

Considering the afternoon menu,
I told her to stop here for this morning.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Top priority updated.
Switching to energy conservation mode until midday.

"...For her sake as well,
I'll tackle the afternoon training with even more spirit."
